Gyeonggi Province · 대한민국 (한국어)

Suwon (수원) — 대한민국 여행 가이드: 명소, 교통편 & 지역 맛집

UNESCO-listed Hwaseong Fortress walls, Haenggung-dong cafés and famous Suwon Wang Galbi.

지역 / 광역시·도Gyeonggi Province
추천 방문 시기Apr–Jun & Sep–Oct
Stay1 day

도시 개요

Suwon (수원) is one of the essential stops in South Korea, located in the Gyeonggi Province region. UNESCO-listed Hwaseong Fortress walls, Haenggung-dong cafés and famous Suwon Wang Galbi.

With direct connections via KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail, Suwon rewards a stay of 1 day so you can balance major landmarks with neighborhood cafés, markets, and easy half-day excursions.

주요 볼거리 및 즐길거리

  • Suwon Historic Center & Main Square: Signature highlight in Suwon — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.
  • Suwon National Museum & Cathedral: Signature highlight in Suwon — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.
  • Suwon Panoramic Viewpoint & Old Quarter: Signature highlight in Suwon — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.

지역 대표 음식 & 특산물

  • Traditional Suwon House Specialty: Iconic local specialty of Suwon and the Gyeonggi Province region.
  • Regional Gyeonggi Province Market Dish: Iconic local specialty of Suwon and the Gyeonggi Province region.
  • Artisanal Gyeonggi Province Pastry & Wine: Iconic local specialty of Suwon and the Gyeonggi Province region.

가는 법 및 대중교통

Suwon is served by KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail and intercity express trains as well as regional airport transfers. Book high-speed legs 2–6 weeks ahead for early-bird fares.

The historic core of Suwon is best explored on foot, supplemented by contactless tap-to-pay metro, tram, or bus lines.

추천 숙박 지역

  • Budget: Well-connected hostels and guesthouses within a 10-minute walk of Suwon's central station or metro lines.
  • Mid-range: Boutique 3-to-4-star hotels near the historic center and pedestrian promenade.
  • Luxury: Heritage 5-star grand hotels and design properties with concierge access and views.
